data.name: 财神模拟器
data.detailed_description:
I'm... alive?

How did I become the God of Wealth?

Who are all these people below? And they want me to grant their wishes?

Huh? I really can do it just by waving my hand!

【Wealth Controller】
As the master of mortal wealth, you hold the power to control it all.
Bestowing a windfall upon someone is but a snap of your fingers.
Those you favor can become immensely rich in an instant.
Those you dislike can be reduced to poverty overnight.
Follow your whims. Your enjoyment is all that matters.

【Ascension Trial】
You start as a novice God of Wealth, overseeing only a small district.
By granting or denying mortal wishes, you'll trigger unforeseen consequences and ultimately accumulate Virtue.
Gathering Virtue allows you to level up, becoming a higher-ranking God of Wealth responsible for larger, more complex regions, drawing you closer to true divinity.
Fail to complete your tasks within the time limit, and this journey will end, casting you back into the cycle of reincarnation.

【Who's Behind All This?】
Why such a bizarre arrangement?
What is Virtue, truly?
What is Wealth, in the end?

Go forth and seek the answers!
